resolution.note: MANY_PRS narrowed, quality test added, task check quality exit 0 before and after

title: One-PR rule fires only on PR counts
body:
Source: lead 2026-11-16: `krn task create` refused an Outcome containing "how many heads" with "declares more than one PR"; MANY_PRS in src/task/quality.ts matches a bare several/many/multi anywhere in the Outcome.
Outcome: the one-pr rule fires only when a plural quantifier or a number of 2 or more directly qualifies PRs or pull requests; an Outcome saying "how m-a-n-y heads" (without the dashes) passes with exit 0.
Why: a false refusal makes leads rewrite correct task text.
Proof: a quality test: "prints how many heads" passes, "split over several PRs" and "3 PRs" still fail.
Files: src/task/quality.ts, test/task/quality.test.ts
